purpose: Target-aligned lodgepole pine for the LUCA-AI SOMPO mountain simulator
reference: .dream-loop/target.png (RDR2 gameplay frame supplied by the owner)

source_images.billboard: built-in image generation, transparent lodgepole pine derived from the target species and palette
source_images.branch_spray: built-in image generation, transparent pine branch spray derived from the target species and palette
source_images.bark: built-in image generation, neutral pine bark material atlas derived from the target palette

notes: Original locally modeled trunk and branch geometry. Runtime uses alpha foliage sprays for near trees and crossed-card billboards only in the mid/far field. No third-party mesh was redistributed.
